title: No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.05401v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. translated_title: 无概念逃脱审计：面向扩散模型可验证概念擦除的审计感知遗忘
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型可能生成违禁内容，这促使研究者通过机器遗忘来实现概念擦除。大多数擦除方法在文本接口层面进行干预，即通过提示词修改或对文本条件化权重的局部更新，并通过模型对给定提示词的输出结果来评估其效果。然而，这种评估方式无法洞察网络内部仍然编码的内容。潜在空间审计方法绕过文本条件化、直接探测去噪网络，结果显示被擦除的概念仍然可以从内部表示中恢复出来。我们发现，即使是那些专门设计用于抵御对抗性提示词的方法，同样存在这一问题，且随着被擦除概念数量的增加，该问题会愈发严重。我们提出了AVCE（面向扩散模型可验证概念擦除的审计感知遗忘）框架，该框架将概念擦除锚定在模型的潜在表示之上。AVCE审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，并通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出AVCE框架，将概念擦除从文本接口下沉到扩散模型的潜在表示层面，通过审计每个概念的嵌入邻域实现可验证的概念擦除，解决了现有基于文本接口的擦除方法仍可从内部表示中恢复被擦除概念、且问题随擦除概念数量增加而加剧的缺陷。
en_tdlr: AVCE grounds concept erasure in a diffusion model's latent representations by auditing each concept's embedding neighborhood, enabling verifiable erasure where existing text-interface-based methods still leave erased concepts recoverable from internal representations.
